function.name: search_patients
function.description: Search for patients by patient's name, ID, or other information (such as demographic information or disease).

search_term.description: The search term to use for finding patients, it can be a patient's name, ID, or other information.

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to return.

function.name: get_patient_details
function.description: Retrieve patient demographics and clinical data, such as medications, allergies, and conditions.

patient_id.description: The unique identifier of the patient.

function.name: search_doctors
function.description: Search for doctors by doctor's name, ID, or specialty.

search_term.description: The search term to use for finding doctors, it can be a doctor's name, ID, or specialty.

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to return.

function.name: manage_clinical_documents
function.description: List, create, update, and delete clinical documents, such as discharge summaries and progress notes.

patient_id.description: The unique identifier of the patient. The identifier should be a string of alphanumeric characters.

action.description: The action to perform on the clinical document.

document_id.description: The unique identifier of the clinical document, required for update and delete actions.

document_data.description: The clinical document data, required for create and update actions. The object includes fields such as 'type', 'date', 'summary', and 'details'.

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to return for the list action.

function.name: manage_appointments
function.description: List, access, create, update, and delete patient appointments.

patient_id.description: The unique identifier of the patient. The identifier should be a string of alphanumeric characters.

action.description: The action to perform on the appointment.

appointment_id.description: The unique identifier of the appointment, required for update and delete actions.

appointment_data.description: The appointment data, required for create and update actions. The object includes fields such as 'date', 'time', 'location', and 'doctor_id'.

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to return for the list action.

function.name: manage_patient_records
function.description: List, create, update, and delete patient records in the EpicFHIR system.

patient_id.description: The unique identifier of the patient. The identifier should be a string of alphanumeric characters.

action.description: The action to perform on the patient record.

record_data.description: The patient record data, required for create and update actions. The object includes fields such as 'name', 'age', 'gender', 'medications', 'allergies', and 'conditions'.

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to return for the list action.

function.name: manage_diagnostic_reports
function.description: List, access, and manage patient diagnostic reports.

patient_id.description: The unique identifier of the patient. The identifier should be a string of alphanumeric characters.

action.description: The action to perform on the diagnostic report.

report_id.description: The unique identifier of the diagnostic report, required for update and delete actions. The identifier should be a string of alphanumeric characters.

report_data.description: The diagnostic report data, required for create and update actions. The object includes fields such as 'type', 'date', 'results', 'interpretation', 'doctor_id', 'doctor_name'.

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to return for the list action, default is 10.

function.name: download_files
function.description: Download files by their unique identifiers.

file_ids.description: The unique identifiers of the files to download. Each should be a valid 'document_id', 'record_id' or 'report_id'.
